jobs.description:
Role : Software Engineer – Ruby (Remote)  
Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere)  

Role Overview:  
We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Ruby (LLM Evaluation & Repository Validation) to work on a Full-Time basis. The projects focus on building LLM evaluation and training datasets that address realistic software engineering problems. One approach involves creating verifiable software engineering tasks from public repository histories using a synthetic method with human‑in‑the‑loop, while expanding coverage across programming languages and difficulty levels.  

Key Responsibilities:  
• Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open‑source libraries to identify suitable evaluation scenarios.  
• Set up and configure code repositories, including Docker containerization and setting preparation for reproducible testing.  
• Evaluate unit test coverage and quality metrics to assess baseline code health and test suite robustness.  
• Modify and run Ruby codebases locally to measure LLM performance in bug‑fixing and code‑completion tasks.  
• Collaborate with AI researchers to design and select repositories and issues that present challenging cases for LLMs.  

Required Skills & Qualifications:  
• Minimum three years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Ruby and Ruby on Rails.  
• Demonstrated expertise with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup for reproducible testing.  
• Ability to navigate and understand complex, real‑world codebases, and to run, modify, and test them locally.  
• Experience with Ruby testing frameworks (RSpec, Minitest), gem management (Bundler), and code quality tooling.  
• Prior contribution to or evaluation of open‑source projects is considered a plus.  

More About the Opportunity:  
This role provides a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the artificial intelligence industry, contributing to how large language models interact with real code. The work directly influences the development of AI‑assisted software development tools and benchmarks.  

Equal Opportunity Employer:  
We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.  

Apply Now!

jobs.title: Senior Ruby Developer - Founding Engineer (India)
jobs.description:
Reports to
CEO Scope
New product - ground-up build, founding engineering seat Location:


Remote, India Type:


Full-time Experience:


10+ years


About CRMified Founded in 2011 by Joshua Hoskins, a Salesforce MVP and Hall of Famer, CRMified delivers Salesforce design and development expertise to mid-market and enterprise clients. We specialize in systems integration with a strong referral-based business, a US-based principal team and a talented delivery team in India.


CRMified runs on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) and we're in an intentional growth phase. Alongside our consulting business, we are now building a new product - and this role is the founding engineering seat for that venture.


About This Role CRMified's CEO is a senior Salesforce technologist with a clear vision for a new product. What he needs is a senior Ruby developer who can be a true thought partner


someone who shapes architecture and product direction with the founder, and then writes the production code to make it real.
This is not a heads-down ticket-execution role and it is not a side gig. It's a full-time, in-seat position for a builder who wants to start a product: high ownership, high ambiguity and a direct line to the founder with no layers in between. You get the upside of building something from zero, backed by the stability of an established, profitable company.


What You'll Own
Product & Technical Direction Partner directly with the founder on product strategy, technical decisions, and architecture - you are the technical voice in the room. Translate product vision into pragmatic technical plans, challenging assumptions and proposing better paths where you see them.


Building & Shipping Design, build, and ship the core product in Ruby on a modern application stack. Own the full engineering lifecycle: architecture, development, deployment (Heroku), and iteration based on real user feedback. Set the engineering foundations - code standards, CI/CD, tooling - that future hires will build on.


AI-Accelerated Development Apply AI concepts (LLM APIs, agents, retrieval, automation) both inside the product and in your own workflow to accelerate development velocity. Advise the founder on where AI genuinely belongs in the product and where it doesn't.


Salesforce Ecosystem Integration Design integrations with the Salesforce platform where the product requires it, drawing on your understanding of its data model and APIs.


What You Bring 10+ years of software development experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Ruby (Rails or comparable frameworks). A track record at well-known brands or products - you've built and shipped software that real users depend on at scale.


Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem: its data model, APIs and how modern applications integrate with it. Heroku and modern application stack experience - comfortable owning deployment, infrastructure, and the full stack. Fluency with AI concepts - you actively use AI tooling in your workflow and can reason about where LLMs, agents, and automation belong in a product. A founder-partner mindset: you want to start a product, not maintain one; you're energized by ambiguity and ownership. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with a US-based founder.


Bonus Points Prior experience as an early or founding engineer at a startup or new product line. Experience building on or alongside Salesforce (AppExchange, Heroku Connect, platform APIs). Experience integrating LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into production applications. Experience in a founder-led, growth-stage firm.

About Emeritus 



 Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 80 top-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China. 

 Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state-of-the-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 300,000 individuals across 80+ countries. 

 Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 1,800 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. The company is backed by prominent investors including Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Leeds Illuminate, Prosus Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, and Bertelsmann. 

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a 

 Ruby on Rails Engineer 

 to join our backend engineering team as an individual contributor. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain production-grade systems that power core platform capabilities such as learner enrollment, order management, and payments. 

 This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own features end-to-end from technical design and development to testing, deployment, and production support within a multi-service Rails ecosystem. 

 We are actively investing in AI-assisted engineering and AI-powered product capabilities. The ideal candidate is not only comfortable leveraging AI tools in their daily workflow but is also excited about shaping how AI integrates into real-world products. You will contribute to building reliable, user-facing AI features going beyond usage to actively influencing how AI enhances product experiences. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Design and implement backend features across enrollment, orders, payments, and related services
Own feature development end-to-end, ensuring clean, maintainable, and well-tested Ruby code
Build, document, and maintain APIs, including keeping documentation up to date
Collaborate with product, QA, and engineering teams on cross-service workflows
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices and standards
Investigate and resolve production issues while improving overall system reliability
Leverage AI tools to enhance development efficiency and team productivity
Explore and prototype AI-powered capabilities that deliver meaningful user or developer value 

 Key Skills, Qualifications and Competencies 

3–5 years of experience building and shipping Ruby on Rails applications in production
Strong fundamentals in Ruby, Rails conventions, and object-oriented design
Solid experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, indexing, query optimization)
Proficiency in building and consuming RESTful/JSON APIs
Experience writing automated tests (RSpec preferred) and maintaining critical test coverage
Ability to work independently as an individual contributor, with strong ownership and execution skills
Strong debugging capabilities across application code, background jobs, and databases
Effective written communication for code reviews, technical documentation, and async collaboration
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to improve coding, testing, debugging, and documentation
Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, write effective prompts, and ensure high-quality, maintainable code
Strong understanding of secure AI usage practices (protecting sensitive data, credentials, and PII)
Demonstrated interest in building AI-powered products or tooling, with curiosity about integrating AI into backend systems responsibly 

 Nice to Have 

 Familiarity with 

 microservices 

 or multi-app ecosystems
Knowledge of 

 payment gateway integrations 

(Stripe or similar)
Experience with modular monoliths, or component-based Rails architectures
Exposure to OpenAPI-driven API development
Experience with feature flags, A/B testing, or gradual rollouts
Prior work in 

 high-traffic, revenue-critical 

 systems 

 What Success Looks Like 

 Within your first six months, you will independently ship production features within at least one Rails application, demonstrating strong ownership through robust test coverage and clear documentation. You will confidently navigate cross-service workflows and be a visible practitioner of AI-augmented engineering, delivering faster without compromising quality, while also contributing meaningfully to at least one initiative focused on AI tooling or product innovation.
